devdoc.details: The engine reads the two EIP-1967 slots directly (see `assess/providers/contract.ts`):      an implementation slot that is set means the code behind this address can change, and the      admin slot names whoever can change it. It then looks that admin up in the risk store —      a flagged admin is the signal, because today's clean code says nothing about tomorrow's      if a sanctioned party can swap it out.      The slots are written straight to storage rather than by deploying a real proxy: what is      being demonstrated is the engine's reading of them, and a forwarding proxy would add a      delegatecall path with nothing to delegate to.

params._admin: The address to present as able to upgrade this contract. Point it at an        address the operator has flagged (e.g. one in TEST_DENYLIST) for the check to fire.
params._implementation: Any non-zero address; its only job is to make the proxy slot set.
